notes.title: Z: Escape Remastered
notes.content:
[b]Z: Escape finally got remastered![/b]

Added features:

- Complete overhaul of the game from 2D into 3D
- Player progression is no longer forced
- Ability to crouch and double jump added
- 4 new types of weapons added
- Life and re-spawn system added
- Story-line changes

Thank you and enjoy the game :)
